form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: A short name for this tool server. Used in the UI, to prefix tool names and in error messages.

g:TextBox.title: A short name for this tool server.

form:FormGroup.label: Endpoint URL
form:FormGroup.helpText: The MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint URL, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp . Both http and https are supported.

g:TextBox.title: The MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint URL.

form:FormGroup.label: Authentication
form:FormGroup.helpText: How Stroom authenticates to this server.

form:FormGroup.label: Credential
form:FormGroup.helpText: The stored credential to authenticate with. For 'Bearer token' and 'Custom API key header' this is an Access Token credential; for 'Basic auth' it is a Username / Password credential.

form:FormGroup.label: API key header name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The HTTP header to send the key in. Default: Authorization

g:TextBox.title: The HTTP header to send the key in.

form:FormGroup.label: API key value prefix
form:FormGroup.helpText: An optional prefix placed before the key value, e.g. 'Bearer '.

g:TextBox.title: An optional prefix placed before the key value.

form:FormGroup.label: Allowed tools
form:FormGroup.helpText: Comma separated patterns for the tools of this server that may be offered to the model, e.g. 'find_*, describe_document'. '*' matches any characters. Leave empty to allow all tools (apart from denied ones).

g:TextBox.title: Patterns for the tools that may be offered to the model.

form:FormGroup.label: Denied tools
form:FormGroup.helpText: Comma separated patterns for the tools of this server that must never be offered to the model, e.g. 'reprocess_*'. Takes precedence over the allowed tools.

g:TextBox.title: Patterns for the tools that must never be offered to the model.
